using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
public static class Strategy { public static string ChooseMove(int turn, string myHistory, string opponentHistory, RpsRandom rng) { if (turn != myHistory.Length || myHistory.Length != opponentHistory.Length) return "X"; if (!Regex.IsMatch(myHistory + opponentHistory, "^[RPS]*$")) return "X"; return new[] { "R", "P", "S" }[turn % 3]; } }
